Font Awesome Free 6.7.2 - selected KWC UI icons
================================================
Source package: @fortawesome/fontawesome-free 6.7.2
Upstream: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome

KWC retains selected original SVG files here for attribution and source traceability.
Runtime UI rendering uses the corresponding path data in frontend/inner/05-fontawesome-icons.js
so all adapter, Standalone, PiP, desktop and mobile presentations share one embedded icon registry.
See LICENSE.txt and the repository root THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
